title: ScenarioDocument
description: The single persisted scenario model shared by JSON, YAML, the editor, and CLI. Parsing establishes the structural shape; [`crate::compile_document`] enforces semantic rules. Owning collections here avoids borrowing source text after parsing.

assertions.description: Reserved declarations; only an empty array is accepted today.

clientProfiles.description: Transport defaults available to workload groups.

environment.description: Scenario-owned configuration variables, not process environment secrets.

groups.description: Workload/lifecycle declarations; current compilation requires one group.

workflows.description: Reusable workflow definitions, each with its own local node/edge IDs.

Environment.description: Scenario-defined JSON variables used for explicit interpolation and scalar references. These are ordinary configuration values, not operating-system credential lookups.

variables.description: Named JSON configuration values available for explicit interpolation and references.

Executor.description: Supported workload scheduling policy; concurrent/ramping policies are not yet executable.

Identity.description: Named credential references consumed by explicit identity-field mappings. The map contains descriptors only; raw credentials belong exclusively to the engine.

credentials.description: Field-name to secret-reference map; no resolved credential values belong here.

IdentityAssignment.description: Select an optional shared identity for explicit identity-field references. Authentication nodes own their own secret references and do not require this assignment.

identityId.description: Assigned identity ID; `None` means no assigned identity.

InitializePhase.description: The lifecycle phase whose exports may feed iteration inputs.

oneOf.description: The successful initialization phase.

InputPort.description: Declare an input's type and optional default. The custom deserializer distinguishes an absent default (`None`) from an explicit JSON null (`Some(Value::Null)`), which semantic validation must reject.

default.description: Optional scalar fallback. Explicit null remains present for validation to reject.

type.description: Declared scalar type; serialized as `type` because `type` is a Rust keyword.

Layout.description: Optional editor positions keyed by workflow-local node ID. Layout affects presentation only; edges determine execution order.

connections.description: Edge-local attachment sides. These affect drawing only, never execution.

positions.description: Local node IDs mapped to finite canvas coordinates.

Lifecycle.description: Optional initialization, required iteration, and optional bounded cleanup. All phases run in the same VU-owned session; frame-local workflow values stay scoped.

cleanup.description: Optional workflow attempted after normal execution or eligible failures/cancellation.

cleanupTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for the entire cleanup call tree in milliseconds; defaults to 2000.

initialize.description: Optional workflow invoked before iteration; its declared exports may feed iteration.

iteration.description: Required workflow invoked once after successful initialization.

MergeConfig.description: Join paired with an exclusive split; it never schedules parallel work.

OutputPort.description: Declare a typed exported scalar and where its value comes from.

type.description: Declared scalar type; serialized as `type` because `type` is a Rust keyword.

value.description: Literal JSON/text or an explicit scalar source, as selected by this variant/type.

PortType.description: Supported scalar port types, checked without automatic coercion.

oneOf.description: A bounded UTF-8 string.

Position.description: One canvas coordinate pair. `f64` is a 64-bit floating-point number; validation rejects NaN and infinity before saving or executing the document.

ProgramEdge.description: A directed connection between local node IDs, with a stable edge ID. Conditions/default routes are permitted only on exclusive split outputs.

condition.description: Optional bounded, read-only FEEL predicate on a split output.

default.description: Fallback-branch marker, serialized as `default`; only true is admitted.
